montserrat.port_info: Little Bay, Montserrat. Tue 12 Jan 2027, ship 8am-6pm. Most ships tender here; confirm whether Ovation tenders.

options.name: The Buried City & Observatory (LTB005)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: about 20 steps up to the Observatory, uneven ground in Plymouth, little shade
options.highlights: Montserrat Volcano Observatory film and briefing, then a driver-guide takes you through Plymouth, the former capital buried under about 40 ft of ash.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Ship tour, so timing is guaranteed. It is short enough to add a beach or snorkel in the afternoon.

options.name: Rendezvous Bay Beach & Snorkel (LTB002)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: boat entry and open-water snorkel; minimum age 12, max weight 250 lb
options.highlights: Boat ride along the coast to Rendezvous Bay, Montserrat's only white-sand beach, with a guided snorkel and about 65 minutes on the beach.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Ship tour. If the sea is rough, Seabourn swaps the beach for a scenic cruise to Plymouth.

options.name: Montserrat Cruise Excursion (Plymouth viewpoint, Observatory, Centre Hills)
options.price_note: Operator website viewed 27 Nov 2026; US$150 per person, 1-4 guests (larger groups cost extra)
options.activity_reason: light walking at viewpoints, air-conditioned vehicle
options.highlights: Local naturalist-guide company. Pickup at the Little Bay pier, then the Plymouth buried-city viewpoint, the Observatory area and a rainforest overlook, with the stops set around your all-aboard time.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Tour is 3 hours and the operator guarantees return before all-aboard. Start by about 9am and you are back around noon, leaving a big buffer before 6pm.

options.name: Plymouth Buried City Tour (Inside the Exclusion Zone)
options.type: guided walking tour inside the restricted zone
options.price_note: Operator website viewed 27 Nov 2026: 'from $398 for 2 persons' (~$199 pp) + $199 per extra person; optional port transfer $120 (up to 4); Observatory fee extra; 'limited dates'
options.activity_reason: light walking on uneven, ash-covered ground; closed-toe shoes
options.highlights: Walk through Plymouth's jetty and old Government HQ and up to the abandoned St. George's Hill village and fort, inside the zone most visitors only see from a distance.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Half day of about 4 hours plus transfers. Book well ahead because zone access depends on the volcano's alert level and limited dates.

options.name: DIY: taxi-tour by the hour
options.price_note: 2023 government maximum tour fare: EC$60/hr (about US$24/hr) per vehicle with 1-4 seats, EC$80/hr (about US$30/hr) for 5-9 seats, so roughly US$85-110 per car for 3.5 hrs. Observatory film about EC$10 (Fodor's, undated).
options.activity_reason: mostly driving with short walks at lookouts
options.highlights: Hire a driver at Little Bay for the Observatory (open Mon-Thu, so Tuesday works), Jack Boy Hill lookout over the buried airport, and the Plymouth viewpoint, with goat-water stew for lunch; the Montserrat Museum is in Little Bay itself.
options.fits_ship_time_note: You set the schedule. Agree the hourly rate and the return time before you leave.

montserrat.pick: For history-minded retirees the best value is a Plymouth/Observatory tour, either Seabourn's 2.5-hr Buried City & Observatory ($120) or Scriber's small-group 3-hr version ($150, more flexible). Montserrat is not a top snorkel destination, so add the Rendezvous Bay snorkel only if you want a second outing.
unverified: Other Seabourn options at this port: Coastal Cruise to Plymouth LTB003 ($100, 2 hr), Speedboat Adventure to Plymouth LTB004 ($250, 2 hr), and Ultimate Montserrat LTB006 ($800, 5 hr, includes Olveston House/AIR Studios and a chef's 3-course meal). The LTB006 page says meals are not included but describes a meal, so confirm.
Seabourn's excursion line-up and prices for the 12 Jan 2027 call were not confirmed; the pages show current 'starting at' prices.
The Scriber's cruise tour page does not show which days it runs; check availability for Tue 12 Jan 2027.
The taxi figures are the 2023 regulated maximums taken from a search summary of the gov.ms PDF; I did not open the PDF itself. Older rate sheets show lower rates.
Observatory days and hours (Mon-Thu, film every 15 minutes from 10:15am to 3:15pm) come from Wikivoyage; confirm before the visit.
Rhonda B. on ToursByLocals offers a 3.5-hr private Historical Montserrat tour (5.0 from 3 reviews) as a further independent choice, but no price was shown.
One TourRadar listing (Nov 2025) mentioned Hurricane Melissa travel disruption. It was not clear the listing was about Montserrat; check current conditions closer to the date.

martinique.port_info: Trois-Ilets, Martinique. Wed 20 Jan 2027, ship 8am-6pm, tender. Euros are used; few drivers take USD.

options.name: To the Bat Cave! Snorkel Martinique (TR2006)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: entry from a dive boat into open water; must be able to swim; no asthma, heart or epilepsy conditions
options.highlights: Dive-boat snorkel at Anse Dufour, where green sea turtles are often seen (not guaranteed), then a guided snorkel under the overhangs of the Bat Cave, with rum punch on the way back.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Ship tour, so tender timing is handled for you.

options.name: Martinique Panorama (TR2001)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: several stops with walking; comfortable shoes advised
options.highlights: Visits La Pagerie, Josephine's birthplace estate, then drives across to the Atlantic coast at Le Francois and a plantation house, ending with a rum distillery tour and tasting.

options.name: A Taste of Martinique (TR2005)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: winding roads (motion sickness warning), light walking
options.highlights: Rhum agricole tasting at the Trois-Rivieres distillery, then a Creole fritter-making lesson with Chef Prisca at the Village de la Poterie; a meal is included.

options.name: Guided Snorkelling Excursion with Turtles in Les Trois-Ilets
options.price_note: From EUR 65 per person on Manawa, viewed 27 Nov 2026 (about US$75; exchange rate not checked). Needs at least 4 participants; non-snorkellers EUR 35.
options.activity_reason: boat entry and 1.5-2 hrs in the water; shorty wetsuit, life jacket and noodles provided
options.highlights: Small group with a PADI instructor; the boat leaves from the dive centre's marina in Trois-Ilets, about 20 minutes from turtle grounds on the way to Anses d'Arlet, and moves on if no turtles are found.
options.fits_ship_time_note: About 3 hours, leaving from Trois-Ilets itself. Book a morning slot so you are back by early afternoon, well ahead of a ~5pm last tender. Departure times are not listed.

options.name: DIY: La Pagerie + Village de la Poterie + taxi to a turtle beach
options.price_note: No reliable published fixed taxi fares found; agree a round-trip price in euros before you go. La Pagerie museum about EUR 5 per adult (guidebooks, undated).
options.activity_reason: beach-entry snorkel and a short walk around the museum grounds
options.highlights: Taxi from Trois-Ilets to Domaine de la Pagerie (Josephine's birthplace museum) and the Village de la Poterie craft village, then on to Grande Anse d'Arlet or Anse Dufour to snorkel from the beach with turtles.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Book the taxi's return trip in advance: one forum poster found a driver who would take them to Anse Dufour but could not come back for them. Aim to be at the tender pier by about 4:30-5pm.

martinique.pick: Do the Seabourn Bat Cave/Anse Dufour snorkel (or the cheaper Espace Plongee turtle trip) in the morning, then take a short taxi to La Pagerie in the afternoon. St. Pierre and the northern distilleries are a long drive from Trois-Ilets on a tender day; I found no Seabourn Trois-Ilets tour that goes there.
unverified: There is also a Seabourn Creole Village Heritage tour (TR2002, $120, 2.75 hr) at La Savane des Esclaves, a reconstructed slave village with a Creole garden; it suits the Creole-architecture interest.
I found no Seabourn Trois-Ilets excursion to St. Pierre. Seabourn's Depaz/St. Pierre tours are listed for Fort-de-France calls (e.g. FDF004), not for this port.
Musee de la Pagerie hours and prices conflict between guidebooks (about EUR 5 adult; days open vary). Call the museum (05 96 68 38 34) or check the Collectivite Territoriale de Martinique site.
Espace Plongee departure times and its exact pier relative to the Seabourn tender landing are not confirmed. The USD figure is a rough conversion.

Civitatis lists a 7.5-hr catamaran with turtle spotting from Grande Anse d'Arlet (from US$119.53, non-refundable, 1 review). It is too long and leaves from the wrong place for this call, so it was left out.
No verified taxi fares from Trois-Ilets to Anse Dufour, Anse Noire or Grande Anse d'Arlet.

bequia.port_info: Port Elizabeth, Bequia. Thu 21 Jan 2027, ship 8am-5pm, tender. Plan to be back at the tender pier by about 4pm.

options.name: Bequia Catamaran Escape: Sail, Snorkel & Sip (BQU015)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: climbing on and off the boat unassisted, open-water snorkel; no heart, back, neck or respiratory conditions
options.highlights: Sail along the coast past the Moonhole cliff houses, snorkel at Princess Margaret Beach, with rum punch on the sail back across Admiralty Bay.

options.name: Bequia Highlights Safari (BQU003)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: steep mountain roads, little shade, short walks
options.highlights: Fort Hamilton's 18th-century hilltop ruins, a fruit tasting at Firefly Estate Plantation and the view from Mount Pleasant, then free time to shop in Port Elizabeth.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Ship tour. The current description no longer includes the Old Hegg Turtle Sanctuary; an older version did.

options.name: Guided Snorkel Trip
options.price_note: approx: 'US$40 / EC$110' from a search snippet of an older product page that now returns 404; the current site shows no price. Confirm by email or phone.
options.highlights: PADI 5-Star shop on the Belmont Walkway runs small-group guided snorkels over the reefs its divers use (e.g. around Devil's Table / Admiralty Bay); gear included, sites chosen on the day.
options.fits_ship_time_note: 2 hours and the shop is a short walk from the tender pier. A morning trip leaves the whole afternoon free.

options.name: DIY: Belmont Walkway to Princess Margaret Beach + taxi to Old Hegg Turtle Sanctuary
options.price_note: Water taxi from Port Elizabeth to Princess Margaret Beach about EC$5-10 pp; island taxi tour about US$25-30 pp for 3-4 hrs (travel guides). Old reports put the taxi to the turtle sanctuary at about EC$80 return (2009) and entry at EC$10. All dated; agree fares before riding.
options.activity_reason: 20-30 min walk each way on the waterfront path and steps, beach-entry snorkel
options.highlights: Walk the Belmont Walkway past the waterfront to Princess Margaret Beach to snorkel off the rocks, browse Port Elizabeth's model-boat workshops, and taxi to the Old Hegg sanctuary, where Orton King raises hawksbill turtles.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Everything is close. Keep the sanctuary visit in the morning or early afternoon and be back at the tender by about 4pm.

bequia.pick: Bequia is small and easy to explore on foot, so we would skip the paid tours: walk the Belmont Walkway to Princess Margaret Beach to snorkel, then take a taxi to Old Hegg and finish at the model-boat shops. Book the Seabourn catamaran ($150) only if you want a guided boat snorkel.
unverified: Dive Bequia's price (US$40) is from an older page; the current site lists no price and its departure times were not found.

Other Seabourn options: Liming Resort Getaway BQU013 ($180, 6 hr, lunch included); Firefly Plantation BQU011 (about $180, 2.5 hr, lunch included, seen in a search snippet only); beach visits BQU014 and BQU016 (prices not checked).
Old Hegg entry fee and taxi fares come from dated reports (2009 to about 2017).
Model-boat shops (e.g. Mauvin's, Sargeant Brothers) are known from general knowledge; I did not verify them in this research.
A Viator 'Bequia Safari' tour that includes the turtle sanctuary was listed as not bookable; Viator, GetYourGuide and Tripadvisor pages could not be loaded (403).
Bequia Dive Adventures (also on the Belmont Walkway, +1 784-458-3826) is a second snorkel operator, but no prices were published.

grenada.port_info: St. George's, Grenada. Fri 22 Jan 2027, ship 8am-6pm, docked at Melville Street cruise terminal.

options.name: Isle of Spice Snorkeling (STG005)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: wade ankle-deep to board, open-water snorkel; no heart, epilepsy, diabetes or asthma conditions
options.highlights: Catamaran up the west coast to snorkel the Molinere Underwater Sculpture Park and reefs, then a swim stop at Grand Anse Beach, with unlimited drinks.
options.fits_ship_time_note: Ship tour leaving from the pier.

options.name: Grenada Mountain Rainforest (STG003)
options.price_note: Seabourn.com listing viewed 27 Nov 2026; 'starting at' price, per person; confirm for Jan 2027 sailing
options.activity_reason: mostly riding with short walks at stops
options.highlights: Laura Herb & Spice Garden, the central plantations, Grand Etang crater lake and Annandale waterfall, with Fort Frederick on the way back to the pier.

options.name: Snorkeling Grenada's Underwater Sculpture Park and Reefs
options.price_note: Sale price on SEG, viewed 27 Nov 2026 (list price $103.99). Not included: taxi to departure point (about 20 min, about US$20) and US$3.50 marine park fee in cash.
options.highlights: Small-group boat to the Molinere Marine Protected Area to snorkel the sculptures and then reefs such as Flamingo Bay or Dragon Bay, depending on conditions.
options.fits_ship_time_note: 3 hours plus taxi transfers; SEG offers a return-to-ship guarantee. With an 8am arrival and 6pm departure there is plenty of slack.
options.rating: SEG sitewide 4.8/5 (58,600+ reviews); no tour-specific rating shown

options.name: Grenada River Tubing & Grand Etang Rainforest Lake Half-Day Tour
options.price_note: approx: US$110 per adult on Expedia and US$120 on Travelocity, from search snippets; the listing pages could not be loaded (429)
options.activity_reason: sitting in a tube through river rapids, getting in and out on rocky banks
options.highlights: Pairs a guided tube float down a rainforest river with a stop at Grand Etang crater lake.
options.fits_ship_time_note: About 4 hours. A search snippet called it an afternoon tour, so confirm a morning start or a pickup by about 12:30pm to keep a comfortable buffer before the 6pm departure.

options.name: DIY: Fort George, Carenage, spice market + Grand Anse
options.price_note: Taxi St. George's to Grand Anse is set by government; quotes range from about US$10 to US$20 per trip. Water taxi from the Carenage about US$4; minibus about US$1 (Cruise Critic/Celebrity port guides). Fort George fee not found.
options.activity_reason: steep uphill streets and steps to Fort George, then beach swimming
options.highlights: Walk from the pier around the Carenage and up to Fort George for harbour views, buy nutmeg and cocoa at the Market Square spice stalls, then take a water taxi or bus to Grand Anse beach for lunch and a swim.
options.fits_ship_time_note: The beach is about 15-25 minutes away by road or boat; aim to be back aboard by about 5pm.

grenada.pick: For snorkelers the Molinere sculpture park is the headline, and Seabourn's Isle of Spice Snorkeling ($100 from the pier, with Grand Anse) is about the same price as independent trips once taxis are added. Do it in the morning, then walk up to Fort George and the spice market. Choose the Mountain Rainforest tour instead if spice and waterfalls matter more than snorkeling.
unverified: Other Seabourn options: Highlights of St George's STG001 ($60, 2 hr, easy) and Grenada Island Drive STG002 ($100, 4 hr, Laura Spice Garden and Grand Etang). Search results also mention a Seabourn River Tubing tour, but I did not open its page or confirm its price.
Explorer Grenada Tours details (price, start time, review count) are from search snippets only, because Expedia and Travelocity returned 429.
Ace Ventura Taxi & Tours lists a cruisers' private tour (Grand Etang, Annandale Falls, Grand Anse) at about US$125 per adult, 9.6/10 on Travelocity; seen in a snippet only.
The SEG tour's departure times and the operator's name were not visible; the marine park fee shows as $3.50 on one listing and $1 on another.
Taxi fare figures conflict between sources (US$10 vs about US$20; currency not always stated). Fort George opening hours and fee were not found.
